raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in the very first step by misidentifying the father of James Douglas, 3rd Earl of Angus. The Planner incorrectly stated that the father was "George Douglas, 2nd Earl of Angus." In reality, the father of James Douglas, 3rd Earl of Angus, was William Douglas, 2nd Earl of Angus (who died in 1437). George Douglas was the 1st Earl of Angus and the grandfather of James. This fundamental lineage error caused the entire subsequent search process to be flawed, as the agents were searching for the birthplace of the wrong person (George, 2nd Earl) instead of the correct person (William, 2nd Earl). Although the Planner eventually corrected this identification in Step 2, the initial error in Step 1 was the root cause of the confusion and the need for extensive re-verification.
